consequences: PLAN Phase 8 and docs/knowledge-brain.md; token savings come from card reuse, compact answers and the brief, measured by a token ledger.
context: The owner wants sati to be the brain for folders of Office, PDF, image and marketing files that AI agents can access.
decision: sati never opens, parses or watches user files. Agents read files with their own tools, track changes and handle language; sati stores what they learned (cards with facts and the file version seen), decided, did, need and plan, and returns it compactly via recall. Rejected: a local document index with built-in Office/PDF extractors and a trigram index, which duplicates what agents already do and adds a file-parsing attack surface.
title: sati remembers; agents read the files
